General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Pcgamer ↗ Open Full Page

All Missing Persons locations in GTA 6

📅 26 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (975 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Pcgamer

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • The GTA 6 Missing Persons case is available as early as Chapter 1, but you'll need access to both Lucia and Jason to wrap up the side quest in Chapter 2.
  • Recent findings suggest that if you begin in Chapter 1 when you can only play as Jason, head straight to the abandoned warehouse to begin.
  • Begin in Chapter 2 by heading to the Starlet Motel lobby in Gellhorn and inspecting the missing persons posters.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

The GTA 6 Missing Persons case is available as early as Chapter 1, but you'll need access to both Lucia and Jason to wrap up the side quest in Chapter 2. Your stint as a fledgling detective begins in an abandoned warehouse near Mo's shop in Gellhorn, though there are two ways to flag the objective on your map and start the hunt for Gellhorn's serial killer.

Recent findings suggest that if you begin in Chapter 1 when you can only play as Jason, head straight to the abandoned warehouse to begin. This is how I began the quest the first time, after following a pack of coyotes through a small opening on the side of the abandoned warehouse. This route gives you an extra text conversation where Jason sends Lucia creepy photos from the warehouse.

Begin in Chapter 2 by heading to the Starlet Motel lobby in Gellhorn and inspecting the missing persons posters. Afterward, head to the abandoned warehouse as a couple or go alone, and squeeze through the crawl space.

Sources indicate that after crawling inside the warehouse, walk to the far end and turn right to enter the glowing red room. Go a little farther to find the, uh, "trophies," and inspect all three lockers, along with the missing persons posters on the wall. This is where you begin your hunt for Gellhorn's three missing tourists.

I've got all three locations highlighted below, but if you want to solve it yourself, now is the time to turn back.

The first missing person in northwest Gellhorn is in an abandoned trailer—the water tower's shadow is your giveaway. Run along the fence and enter the blue building from the back. There's an awfully suspicious hole in the floor, so pull the remaining floorboards back to discover what's left of Patrick Murray.

In a recent development, call the Kelly County Tip Line after you find Patrick's remains and leave a message. No one will answer the phone, for now.

Keep up to date with the most vital stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.

In a recent development, the second missing person is in the junkyard, inside the trunk of an old pink DeVanity. The junkyard is right beside Pay 'n' Spray off Gellhorn Ave, across the street from the drive-in theatre. You'll spot Susanne Keeble's pink car with the PRTYGRL license plate while facing the drive-in.

After finding a second body, call the tip line again to finally speak to an investigator. They're thrilled to hear there's renewed interest in the case, and ask that you keep in contact should you make any further discoveries.

In a recent development, the third missing person is in a U-shaped inlet off the Borrachero Sound. You can find the smaller body of water by traveling southeast from the Wild Hog Point hangar. The view of Wild Hog Point from the tree in the creepy photo is your giveaway, so start looking for a submerged car when you find the right perspective.

Industry observers note that after finding a third body, the investigator from the tip line asks to meet in the abandoned warehouse. And no, it's not just you, it's a pretty shady proposition.

When you're ready for the meeting, consider whether you want to go with your partner or go alone. Both seem to give me the same boost to Jason and Lucia's relationship status, elevating it to Hot Together (4/4) status for the first time in Chapter 2. It had dropped all the way down to Partners in Crime (2/4) just before this, so the Missing Persons quest was a much-appreciated bump.

You can also get the serial killer's glasses from his body if you choose to continue as a couple. They're beyond creepy, so I wouldn't blame you if you left them there, but aside from that, there's no cash reward. You will have to do it, though, if you're going for a 100% GTA 6 run.

As either Jason or Lucia, return to the abandoned warehouse trophy room and meet Alvan West—the man you spoke to on the Kelly County Tips Line. He's got a 'surprise' waiting for you in the fourth locker, and a fight ensues after checking it out.

In a recent development, going alone means there's no one there to save the passed out Jason or Lucia, and the serial killer takes them to a cave in Lummox County. The attack automatically triggers a character swap, leaving you to investigate your partner's whereabouts after receiving suspicious texts.

Enter the abandoned warehouse trophy room just like before while your partner waits outside. When they sense something is off, they'll run inside to save you just as you pass out. After Alvan is dead, inspect his body—you can take his glasses as a souvenir. That's freak behavior, but I'm not judging. We gotta get that 100% cosmetic collection somehow.

Her weekly to-do always includes a bit of MMO time, endlessly achievement hunting and raiding in Final Fantasy 14. Outside of those staples, she's often got a few survival-crafting games on rotation and loves a good scare in co-op horror games.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, getting to be a part of a Hallmark movie that intertwines romance and the magic of Walt Disney World is incredibly cool all on its own. However, when you’re Patrick Renna and you get to play Skipper in the 2026 TV schedule's Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True, you also delight in the joke-telling that comes with getting to take over Walt Disney World’s Jingle Cruise.

It’s heartwarming to watch The Sandlot star put on the Jungle Cruise uniform and don a Cast Member name badge as he gets the once-in-a-lifetime experience of being the boss of his own ride vehicle. He's joined a very exclusive club that few actors will ever be a part of, and I loved seeing him do what Frozen star Josh Gad did as part of a YouTube series where he takes on Cast Member jobs. Honestly, it made my heart grow watching Renna steer the cast through the attraction. Check out the clip for yourself:.

A post shared by Hallmark Channel (@hallmarkchannel).

Industry observers note that now, this was done for the film Holiday Ever After. Its star, Lacey Chabert, has always been a Disney girl, so I get why she’d want to be a part of a project like this. Not only did she get to actually film a movie inside the Magic Kingdom, but she also got to stay at the resort for the entire length of the shoot. And she shared the Disney magic of it all with her co-stars.

Recent findings suggest that the Jungle Cruise is one of Disney’s most iconic attractions, so getting to be on the boat as more than just a theme park fan must be better than words can describe. And for Patrick Renna, it was a dream come true that he couldn’t help but sound in awe of. In the clip, he shared:.

According to recent reports, this is every man’s dream. This is incredible. Just walking here at 6 a.m. with no one here was one of the coolest experiences I’ve ever had.

While I’ve never gotten to take over an attraction in the theme parks, I have been lucky enough during media events to walk around Disneyland and Disney World in the early morning hours before guests arrive. I even got to take a spin on the Jungle Cruise before opening, after changes had been made to the attraction. I agree with the Dugout Dads star that not only was it absolutely the coolest experience, but also one that I’ll never forget.

If you know anything about the Jungle Cruise, chances are that you’re also familiar with the “back side of water,” as you get to see the reverse side of the waterfall. Whether it’s the classic version or the Jingle Cruise holiday edition, Jungle Cruise puns are the most crucial part of the experience, so it was delightful to see Patrick Renna get in on that as well.

All of this just makes me even more excited to watch this Hallmark Christmas movie release that seems to really embrace the holidays at Walt Disney World. If you're in the same boat (see what I did there), you can catch Holiday Ever After on the Hallmark Channel on Saturday, November 28 at 8 p.m. ET, or you can stream it on Hallmark+, Hulu or with a Disney+ subscription the next day.

💡 Key Takeaways

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that A upcoming survey of Grand Theft Auto 6 players has found some particularly interesting results. 30 percent came away from the game with the desire to buy someone special flowers. Nine percent punched cats.

Sources indicate that per Games User Research's director Steve Bromley, 303 players from across the UK and US were polled on their experiences. They had to have at least two hours of playtime to contribute, which led to an informed sample of how folks are finding the game.

In a recent development, those polled gave the game an 8.4/10 (that's 4.2/5 Eurogamer readers), which is glowing praise. 42 percent loved the narrative, as well as Jason and Lucia's relationship. 38 dug the lifelike and believable world, while 35 percent were keen on the freedom to explore and the variety of activities.

As for what they didn't like, 28 percent weren't a fan of the slow pacing and long cutscenes, 19 percent didn't like the difficulty in stealing cars and losing a wanted level, while 18 percent were put off by the game's technical performance.

Now for some fun findings: 41 percent expressed an interest in improving their real life after playing the game, with 30 percent of those looking to buy a loved one some flowers. Nice! 14 percent were at least once confused or stuck, due to confusion with the stealth, identifying time-sensitive missions, or experiencing control challenges.

There's some bad news for the cats out there, too. Nine percent accidentally punched a cat while trying to pet it, while 61 percent had the same experience with human NPCs. At least it wasn't intentional, that has to count for something. Right?

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that “Cancer does change you,” Kate Middleton notes, emotion clear in her voice. “It changes your body, it changes you physically. But there’s a much, much deeper part to what a cancer diagnosis shifts in you.” These words come not at as an Instagram post or at a public event. Instead, they're the voice-over in a previously unannounced documentary about the Princess of Wales and her life since she disclosed a diagnosis of cancer in 2024.

According to Kensington Palace, which revealed the film on Saturday, Heal is “a deeply personal new documentary from The Princess of Wales, exploring life beyond diagnosis and the many ways people find comfort, strength and hope in the face of serious illness.” It will air on the BBC in the UK on November 29, and in the US on NBCUniversal on November 30.

It has been revealed that heal follows Kate Middleton during her participation in one of the United Kingdom’s most demanding endurance events: The National Three Peaks Challenge, which she completed this summer. In less than 24 hours, the princess climbed the three highest mountains in Scotland, England, and Wales: Ben Nevis (4,413 feet), Scafell Pike (3,209 feet), and Yr Wyddfa–Snowdon (3,559 feet). The undertaking wasn't just a personal effort, as it was also in support of the Royal Marsden Cancer Charity, an organization that supports people living with cancer before, during, and after the disease.

The documentary will also support that organization, Kensington Palace notes, saying “All funds received through the documentary's distribution have been directed to The Royal Marsden Cancer Charity to help people living with and beyond cancer.” The Royal Marsden Hospital, at which Middleton received treatment, is also referenced in the film, as Middleton's brother, James, asks her “Isn’t it when you leave the Royal Marsden, you ring the bell?”.

But while many patients participate in the bell-ringing ritual at the conclusion of treatment, Middleton indicates she missed out on that moment. “Yeah, but I didn’t ring the bell,” she replies. “So maybe this is your ringing of the bell,” James responded, suggesting her Three Peaks experience was that symbolic peal.

While Prince William is no stranger to documentary work, nor are Prince Harry and wife Meghan Markle, this is Kate Middleton's first venture into the format. Perhaps to ease her into the project, Heal's Director of Photography is a face quite familiar to the Princess: Will Warr, the filmmaker behind her video announcement marking the end of her chemotherapy treatments.

Recent findings suggest that “Through this documentary, The Princess hopes to help others navigate diagnosis, recovery and life beyond cancer and transform access to holistic cancer care which supports wellbeing, resilience and quality of life during and after diagnosis,” Kensington Palace indicates of Heal, a message underscored by Middleton's words in the trailer. “You know, healing is a journey. How to reconnect with the things you once knew and how to find a sense of hope and joy alongside uncertainty.”.

“It’s clear we're not meant to face life’s challenges alone,” the princess says as the trailer concludes. “Things can renew and grow. Often it is through pain that we realize that there is a greater beauty that lies beyond that.".

We are already in a world where people think about promoting games as human-made, Citizen Sleeper creator says

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Citizen Sleeper creator Gareth Damian Martin - also known by their studio name Jump Over the Age - believes we're reaching a point of gen-AI saturation whereby game-makers are starting to counter-promote games as being human-made.
  • It has been revealed that "We already are.
  • It's a label I haven't seen circulating in games yet, but we have seen an increase in the number of AI disclosures for games being sold on Steam, and many videos on YouTube now carry 'No AI' badges, in an effort to stand out from the torrent of videos made using gen-AI.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Citizen Sleeper creator Gareth Damian Martin - also known by their studio name Jump Over the Age - believes we're reaching a point of gen-AI saturation whereby game-makers are starting to counter-promote games as being human-made.

It has been revealed that "We already are. Yeah, yeah, yeah. 100 percent," Damian Martin told me in an interview, while discussing their striking new game Signet City. "That was already something that my publisher [Fellow Traveller] was saying they want to do with my games more, especially with me doing the art this time as well. Yeah, 100 percent - it's going to give rise to that.".

It's a label I haven't seen circulating in games yet, but we have seen an increase in the number of AI disclosures for games being sold on Steam, and many videos on YouTube now carry 'No AI' badges, in an effort to stand out from the torrent of videos made using gen-AI. We are already seeing Steam events dedicated to games without any AI usage whatsoever. Things are clearly changing.

Damian Martin told me "the only good thing" that could come from gen-AI use is a bounce-back effect of people noticing and cherishing human-made things more. They were reminded of this while looking at a Rembrandt sketch while doing a brief stint in art school ahead of Signet City (the art in the Citizen Sleeper games was commissioned, but the art in Signet City is done by them). In the sketch, the faces had been scribbled out, presumably because Rembrandt didn't like the work he'd done. They were scribbles that revealed the humanity of the creator.

According to recent reports, "You suddenly remember that trying to represent a human face by using a pencil and a piece of paper is something that's been happening for hundreds of years," Damian Martin remarked. "So when you do it, you're connecting to an entire history of that challenge and that opportunity, and it's fascinating to me to engage and be part of that. It's really beautiful.

"If AI makes us notice that more," they added, "then I think that's great. If we can make a counter-punch, if we can find that energy, that's great. I certainly think if it gives value to human-made things, in a way that perhaps we'd been forgetting, then that's the only good thing that can come from that process.".

Industry observers note that to be clear, Damian Martin is not using gen-AI in making Signet City, a game about being a parasite in people's heads in a fictional version of Newcastle in the 1980s and then influencing what they do. It's a game with a distinct hand-drawn look, presented in a thick-lined, moody black-and-white way, and with bleak industrial backgrounds and post-punk influences and energy. Indeed, the idea Damian Martin would use gen-AI in any way runs counter and contrary to what they're known for.

"I exist in this space where the idea that I would use AI is kind of mad," they noted. "It's a bit like me saying, 'I'm going to start buying all of my art materials from the asset store on Unity.' The reason people buy my games is because they come from me, and the only evidence I have - the only thing I can trust - is my own expression and identity. That's the thing that's worked for me; there's no other judgeable thing. So I'm working to put more of that into my games.

"But there is a real threat," they added, "and the reason there is a real threat in the wider games industry is because it's an industry, and people who work on games for substantial companies, in my experience, are treated very poorly. They are not respected as human beings in a lot of cases. So why would they not be replaced by machines if the people who pay their wages do not even respect their human nature? They do not respect their creativity. We've seen such a lack of respect for expression, for directors, for individuals within games.".

In a recent development, "When something is industrial production and it doesn't care about the people involved, then it doesn't care whether they're machines or they're people as long as the work happens, and that's the real threat," they reiterated. "So we do have to be vigilant, and we do have to be loud and say stuff, and say that it's not okay for us, because otherwise it will happen. It just seems inevitable that you would try to automate these things because it's easier than having employees; that's the kind of horrible logic of industry, unfortunately. But that doesn't really concern me because I'm operating in a completely different mode.".

According to recent reports, signet City at the moment has no release date but was said to be halfway through development when unveiled this summer. Citizen Sleeper 2 - Damian Martin's most recent game - was released at the beginning of 2025. It's a sequel that introduced more pressure into the heartwarming sci-fi, dice-rolling, role-playing series, and I thought it better for it. "With a newly introduced found sense of tension, and showpiece Contract missions, Citizen Sleeper is transformed. This follow-up has improved the RPG formula in every way," I wrote in my Citizen Sleeper 2 review.

It’s been three years since Michael Dorn reprised his role as Worf in Picard season 3. The Klingon Federation officer had turned to spycraft and was “working on himself” in his older age, combining a wiser outlook with John Wick-style combat skills. He was by far the most interesting character left to still explore from the Star Trek: The Next Generation era, and according to Dorn, Paramount was considering a newly introduced TV spin-off that would have done just that.

“I pitched a Worf show to Alex Kurtzman,” Dorn said during a recent episode of the podcast The Show People (via The Nerdist). “And it was purely Star Trek: Worf. Getting back to what it was. He wasnât Captain [of a Federation starship]. He was trying to hold the Klingon Empire together. But he was on a ship, going out into space.”.

It has been revealed that he continued, “And they said âWell, thatâs very interesting Michael, but we have six episodes already written for a Worf show.â And I said âOh, okay.â And they were down the road with it. Then, all of a sudden, from what I understand, and I heard this straight from the horseâs mouth, a new regime came into the CBS/Paramount thing, and said âNo, no, we donât want that.â”.

Worf was one of the few characters to meaningfully continue on after TNG. Even before Picard, Dorn had developed the character across several big arcs in Deep Space Nine. A pitch and initial scripts are far from a developed series, but it’s not hard to see how a new Star Trek: Worf spin-off could have delivered on some of what the other modern Trek series have been lacking.

Instead, Paramount doesn’t appear to be moving forward with any new Star Trek ideas. Strange New WorldsÂ will get a final fifth season and Starfleet Academy is set to debut its second and final season in 2027. Outside of those two very uneven shows, David Ellison’s Skydance doesn’t appear to have much else cooking when it comes to Trek.

The executive producer on the movies Star Trek Into Darkness and Star Trek Beyond is reportedly not very interested in the streaming side of Star Trek’s future, even though the franchise’s most successful movies all grew out of TV series. James McAvoy reportedly pitched a prequel about a younger Picard that would have followed the captain’s years aboard the Stargazer and it went nowhere. Star Trek: Legacy, a modern successor to TNG set up in Picard‘s final season, also got lost in the shuffle around Ellison’s takeover of Paramount.

According to recent reports, I’ve been loving the Star Trek Universes Beyond set for Magic: The Gathering. It’s a perfect ode to the many storytelling highlights from across the different eras of Trek. There have been some decent game adaptations recently, too, but none of those are a substitute for an actual show. Maybe HBO can help Paramount figure one out now that they’re part of the same billionaire’s toy box.

While there is still much to parse from the multifaceted performer, we should take a minute to remember the scholar who lived inside our computer encyclopedias.

It's official: After more than five years together and nearly a year of engagement, Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando have tied the knot. The couple were married in the desert hot spot of Palm Springs, California on Saturday, November 21, an outdoor ceremony held at Frank Sinatra’s former mansion, with Wayne Coyne, frontman of The Flaming Lips and a Cyrus collaborator, officiating.

Recent findings suggest that the 33-year-old singer and the 28-year-old musician—Morando is the drummer for the band Liily—had kept their prepares a secret until Friday, when TMZ broke the news. Confirmation of the impending celebration emerged that same evening, during the dinner that capped off the rehearsal, when Miley’s half-sister, Lily-Rose Purcell, posted a photo on her Instagram Stories of a menu featuring the couple’s initials. This is Cyrus’s second marriage, following her alliance with actor Liam Hemsworth from 2018 to 2019.

Sinatra’s former home in Palm Springs, where the wedding took place.

In a recent development, according to images published in outlets including People, the ceremony venue was decorated with white flowers and large candles, with Sinatra’s pool in the background. Miley Cyrus wore a long-sleeved white satin dress with a plunging back and no veil, while the groom opted for a classic black tuxedo with a bow tie.

According to recent reports, among the guests were the bride’s mother, Tish Cyrus, accompanied by her husband, actor Dominic Purcell, and Miley's sister, Noah Cyrus. Also in attendance was the singer’s father, Billy Ray Cyrus, along with his rumored fiancée, British actress Elizabeth Hurley, and her son, Damian.

Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando on February 01, 2026.

In a recent development, as the bride has recounted in past interviews, her relationship with her now-husband began in 2021 following a blind date organized by mutual friends. That same year, they went public by attending the singer’s Fresh Year’s Eve TV special in Miami together. Their engagement came to light in December 2025, when, during another of those joint appearances, Miley Cyrus posed on the red carpet wearing a diamond ring that turned out to be her engagement ring.

One of the most emotional moments of the ceremony took place just before the couple exchanged their vows, when—according to multiple outlets— Dolly Parton’s “Love Is Like a Butterfly” began to play. The nod follows a similar one Miley made last month, when she broke down in tears over Parton's death during a performance at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles.

“Me and Dolly, we are eternal. Nothing in this life could ever tear us apart, and I’m gonna see her again,” Cyrus told the stadium crowd in October, per The Hollywood Reporter. “And I can’t fucking wait because I miss her,” Cyrus tearfully continued. “Some of the greatest music that we have today was written, produced, performed by my Aunt Dolly.".

10 Hacks Every 'GTA 6' Player Should Know

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 6 min read (1240 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Lifehacker

⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • I've been playing Grand Theft Auto VI since launch, and I'm having a blast so far.
  • In a recent development, I'm not going to share any spoilers here, but you should know that the side quests in Chapter 1 are crucial.
  • If you're used to playing racing games, you'll find the driving experience in GTA VI to be quite different.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

I've been playing Grand Theft Auto VI since launch, and I'm having a blast so far. The world feels even more detailed and immersive than previous GTA games, which means there's a lot to learn beyond the basic tutorials and prompts the game shares at the beginning. These are the 10 GTA 6 hacks I used to improve the game's quality of life. If you do the same, you'll spend more time immersed in the world, and less time fighting the game's default settings.

In a recent development, I'm not going to share any spoilers here, but you should know that the side quests in Chapter 1 are crucial. If you ignore all the optional quests or small asks by other characters, you won't be able to return to those later. These are small things like fixing up the house for Lucia, meditating with her, and buying her a necklace when she asks you to. All of these have an impact on your progress. Take your time in this chapter, and remember to save before starting the mission called "Recalibration." That mission leads to Tourist Trap, which is the point of no return for Chapter 1.

If you're used to playing racing games, you'll find the driving experience in GTA VI to be quite different. It's hard to keep an eye on minimap directions while you're also getting used to vehicles in the game, and I used voice navigation to ensure that I don't keep getting lost, particularly for time-sensitive missions. You can enable this by going to GTA VI settings > Audio > GPS Voice > Voice. If you're playing the game on PS5, your DualSense controller's speaker plays GPS voice prompts. This is great as those alerts can be hard to hear over all other in-game sounds from your TV's speaker.

Industry observers note that using GTA 6's default controls, making Jason and Lucia run is quite annoying. The game makes you hold L3 to run, which hurts my thumbs. If you alter movement speed in settings, you can make the characters run just by using the left stick. You can walk by easing off the left stick, or switch to a fast walk, jog, or run when you push the stick all the way. Tweak this by going to GTA VI settings > Gameplay > Movement Speed > Jog. This lets you move faster without draining your stamina. You can also change from Jog to Run if you want the fastest possible movement speed with the left stick. Having said that, my pro tip is to go to Control Scheme in settings, and switch to Classic. This lets you run by holding the X button, as opposed to L3 with default controls.

Haptic strength is one area where GTA 6 takes the immersion a bit too far, as it's dialed up to the maximum level by default. This makes the controller's vibration strength a bit too intense for my liking, and also has a negative impact on battery life. You can fix that by reducing haptic strength a little. It's under GTA VI settings > Controller > Vibration & Haptics Strength.

Many modern controllers develop "stick drift," an glitch where small movements of the analog sticks register as large inputs. This causes a big problem in games that require precise inputs, such as GTA 6. To counter this potential problem, the game allows you to adjust the deadzone for each analog stick in your controller. That mentioned, this setting can be used to your advantage, even if you don't have stick drift problems in your controller. I recommend dialing up the deadzone to 7 to improve the driving experience. I find most cars in GTA 6 to be a bit floaty to drive, and adjusting the deadzone fixes this issue to a large extent.

Recent findings suggest that committing a heist attracts heat in GTA 6, and there are many different ways to escape the attention of in-game cops. The usual tricks include stocking up on outfits to change into, parking your vehicle a block or two away, and being so stealthy that you leave no witnesses to your crimes. However, an underrated trick involves using the pickup truck you get at the start of the game. Get a bike in the game, and stash it in your pickup truck. Then, use the truck to drive to the crime scene, and hide the truck a short distance away. Unload the bike, and use it to get to the crime scene. Once the heist is complete, ditch the bike, and run to your truck. Witnesses won't have seen you using the truck, which allows you to escape the area quickly.

Recent findings suggest that if you are using a car as a getaway vehicle, you can use two tricks to make a smooth escape. First, double-tap the Triangle button to exit your vehicle without switching off its engine. When you return to the vehicle in a hurry, you can escape a lot faster. If you have quick fingers, you can double-tap Triangle first, and just as your character is about to exit the vehicle, press L3 (or X, if you use classic controls). This leaves the car's door open, and saves you a little more time when you're fleeing.

I suffer from chronic migraines, and I am sensitive to bright lights. Fortunately, GTA 6 has a bunch of accessibility settings that help me play the game for longer. Even if you don't face the same concerns, these settings will help reduce eye strain in longer play sessions. Go to GTA VI settings > Display > Flashbang, and switch to Dark. This stops flashbangs from showing a bright white light when they go off. On the same settings page, you can tweak Player Status Effects Intensity to reduce screen effects when your character is low on health or stamina. You can also enable Brightness Reduction to reduce the intensity of bright lights in the game, and try Focus Trail Colorblind Mode if you find it hard to distinguish between different colors.

I haven't been able to play first-person shooters for decades because the camera movement makes me nauseous and gives me a headache. Of late, I've noticed that it's getting harder to play third-person games too. My first two hours in GTA 6 had me quite worried because I was feeling quite sick, and I had to turn off my PS5. Luckily for me, I found a few tweaks to mitigate this problem. You can do that in GTA VI settings > UI > Persistent Center Dot. This permanently indicates a white dot in the center of the screen, and it reduced my motion sickness enough to help me play the game. You can also go to GTA VI settings > Camera, reduce Camera Bob, and turn off Camera Shake, and Weapon Sway. I also recommend going to the Controller tab in settings, and tweaking all the options under Aim & Look Sensitivity until you find a comfortable level.

GTA 6 includes realistic ringing sounds that linger after explosions in the game. This may be fine for some people, but it can negatively affect some players' gaming sessions. Those who suffer from tinnitus or chronic migraines may not enjoy those ringing sounds, and, luckily, the game allows you to disable them. Open GTA 6's in-game settings, and enable the feature from Audio > Tinnitus Reduction.

Rockstar Games employees vote against union recognition

📅 26 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (517 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Eurogamer

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Rockstar Games employees have voted against official recognition of the Rockstar Game Workers Union, with 93.2 percent of staff participating in the vote.
  • 25 percent of those who participated voted to recognise the union, while 75 percent voted against.
  • Recent findings suggest that jennifer Kolbe, head of publishing at Rockstar Games told Eurogamer: "We are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Rockstar Games employees have voted against official recognition of the Rockstar Game Workers Union, with 93.2 percent of staff participating in the vote.

25 percent of those who participated voted to recognise the union, while 75 percent voted against. If it had been approved, it would have been the largest recognised union in the UK video game industry by a large margin. While the union will still exist and organise, Rockstar Games will not have to recognise the union as a representing body for staff at the studio, and is not obligated to attend regular meetings with the body.

Recent findings suggest that jennifer Kolbe, head of publishing at Rockstar Games told Eurogamer: "We are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6. This result reflects our team's strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong. As we look ahead, we're excited to build on all we've accomplished together.".

The Rockstar Union also released a statement following the outcome of this vote, saying Rockstar employees will continue to organise despite the lack of recognition. It reads:.

"For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society - this isn't a sign to retreat, it's a sign to double down on what we stand for. Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognise we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues. We're ready to put in the effort to make that happen.

Recent findings suggest that "Whilst we haven't emerged with a recognition deal, this ballot has put our union on the radar of every worker, and opened the door for new kinds of conversation to start happening. People entirely unfamiliar with unions were for the first time debating employment conditions, collective bargaining rights, and our contracts. We heard from many more colleagues about what mattered to them, and we hope people will continue to engage so that we can see where these new discussions can lead us.

According to recent reports, "A recognition agreement would have marked a path towards greater workplace democracy. But it's one route of many. At Rockstar we have already won, and will continue to win, tangible changes that improve our everyday lives. We'll keep fighting for a say. For pay transparency, contractual overtime pay, and protections against Al and layoffs.

"The power to shape our working lives has always been, and will always be, in our hands.".

Sources indicate that rockstar employees represented by the union are still awaiting the verdict from the Rockstar Games vs IWGB employment tribunal legal case, of which the final verdict is still pending. This case was kicked off by the sudden firing of employees present in a union Discord server. The employees claim this was an attempt at union busting by Rockstar, while the company denies this, saying it was for breaking confidentiality agreements.
